quote:
A covenant drawn under fluorescent lights may turn to dust when the wind of truth rustles its own pages.

The echoes of distant artillery can make the earth itself pause, reminding us that even calm rivers can be broken by hidden stones.

Airports are temples of motion where hope and threat are offered in equal measure, one trembling row after another on the altar of steel.

When a floral bouquet lies dead in a parking lot, the scent of lilies hides the memory of a jagged blade.

A nation's shield grows stronger only when it first knows the weight of its own armor against the thunder of inevitable storms.

The shackles of a nation’s prison bars do not silence the voice of the spirit; it waits, patient, to rise again like wind in the pine.

In the quiet of a besieged ward, a child’s breath jestingly whispers, "I am still here" amid a storm of doubters.
